gizmo.title: Ọtụtụ nhọrọ
gizmo.description: Ajụjụ nlele onwe nwere ọtụtụ nhọrọ.

advanced.title: Nwere ike ịdaba
advanced.description: Gosi ajụjụ a dị ka ahịrị na-emeghe ma na-emechi. Imeghe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ nwere ike ịdaba dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite ka ọ daba
advanced.description: Mgbe ọ nwere ike ịdaba, ọ na-amalite dị ka ahịrị emechiri nke na-egosi naanị ajụjụ na ọnọdụ ya.

advanced.title: Usoro akara
advanced.description: OER Schema: usoro akara maka nyocha a (dịka akara, mkpụrụedemede, pasentị, mmecha).

advanced.title: Ebumnuche mmụta
advanced.description: OER Schema: ebumnuche mmụta jikọtara na nyocha a.

developer.title: Aha ule
developer.description: Aha ule eji maka njirimara xAPI na usoro nyocha data.

developer.title: Kọọsị
developer.description: OER Schema: kọọsị e mere nyocha a maka ya.
